title: Ellsworth silo abandoned with access plug open
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: And in 1978, one year after Mario and Michael, a security team at the base abandoned a silo with the access plug open

plain: In 1978, a security team at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota is said to have left one of its underground nuclear missile silos with the access plug, the heavy hatch that seals it, standing open. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about two Air Force veterans who say they were abducted the year before. He offers it as another strange event at the same missile field.
